answer: Save the lowest offset not yet written, the low-water mark just below the first unfinished record, so everything under it is confirmed and a crash only replays work. Saving the highest finished position instead lets the committed offset jump past records still in flight in lower offsets. After a crash, restart resumes beyond them, so those records are skipped for good, which is silent data loss. Replays of finished records would be harmless, but skipped records are not. Source: pa_pattern_backpressure_scaling.md, L161.
